objective: Close exactly the five uncaptured completeness boundaries before constructing any new R1 expected manifest.

archive_member_inventory.requirement: Enumerate every entry of every ordered runtime archive, not just resolved class-bearing artifacts.
capture: ordered effective classpath entry index and immutable whole-archive SHA-256
for every archive: normalized member path, entry type, compression method, uncompressed size, compressed size when applicable, CRC when applicable, and SHA-256 of uncompressed member bytes
duplicate member paths across archives with first-visible/shadowed disposition under effective classpath order
directories, resources, service descriptors, META-INF entries, generated/synthetic class files and non-class payloads
standalone runtime directories recursively with relative path, file type, size and SHA-256
archive_member_inventory.fail_closed: Any unreadable archive, duplicate whose visibility cannot be resolved, missing member digest or unenumerated runtime directory blocks the capture.

complete_build_inputs.requirement: Bind the complete source-to-runtime build input universe used to produce the captured runtime.
capture: settings.gradle/settings.gradle.kts and every included build declaration
all build.gradle/build.gradle.kts files participating in the build graph
buildSrc and convention/plugin source trees
gradle wrapper properties plus exact Gradle distribution SHA-256
version catalogs, dependency lockfiles, dependency-verification metadata and repository declarations
compiler/plugin coordinates and exact resolved artifacts
effective Kotlin/JVM/compiler flags and toolchain selection
generated-source/resource inputs and generators
explicit allowlisted environment/build properties that affect resolution or compilation
complete_build_inputs.fail_closed: Any dynamically consulted build input outside the captured inventory blocks manifest construction.

immutable_platform_identity.requirement: Execute the supplemental capture only inside a predeclared immutable container/VM image addressed by digest.
pre_execution_binding: image reference plus immutable image digest
kernel/host interface facts required by the boundary proposal
supplemental_capture: Python executable and closure identities already required by prior evidence
locale/timezone/encoding inputs if observable by the runtime
immutable_platform_identity.fail_closed: A mutable tag without immutable digest, or image/Java mismatch at runtime, aborts before build/test launch.

complete_process_launch_path.requirement: Preserve the ordered launcher-to-daemon-to-worker path and exact process-visible inputs.
capture: launcher executable/script bytes and SHA-256
canonical argv vector for launcher, Gradle daemon and test worker
working directory for each process
exact allowlisted environment key/value map after redaction-safe normalization; unexpected keys fail unless explicitly non-semantic
ordered classpath/module-path for daemon and worker
JVM args/system properties
mount mapping with source identity, target path and read/write mode
parent-child process topology with executable hashes
complete_process_launch_path.fail_closed: Unexpected process, executable, mount, environment input, argv mutation or classpath mutation blocks acceptance.

generated_hidden_class_policy.requirement: The independent review must choose exactly one policy accepted by the existing validator: ELIMINATED or PINNED_GENERATOR_INPUTS.

eliminated.condition: Demonstrate that no generated/hidden runtime classes relevant to the tested boundary are created.
eliminated.evidence: instrumented class-definition census plus repeat run proving zero generated/hidden relevant classes

pinned_generator_inputs.condition: When generated/hidden classes exist, bind every generator implementation and semantic input necessary to reproduce them.
evidence: generated class census including defining loader, logical origin and resulting byte hash whenever bytes are retrievable
deterministic repeat comparison or explicit validator-approved equivalence rule for VM-hidden classes whose names are nondeterministic

generated_hidden_class_policy.fail_closed: No generated/hidden class family may be silently excluded.

execution_shape.phase_0: Independent design review only. No JVM or capture execution.
execution_shape.phase_1: After design acceptance, predeclare immutable platform image and exact capture workflow/source bytes.
execution_shape.phase_2: One fresh single-source supplemental hermetic capture; preserve raw inventories before any validator decision.
execution_shape.phase_3: Independent audit of the original artifact for binding, completeness, digests and five closure requirements.
execution_shape.phase_4: Only if clean, construct a complete expected manifest from captured bytes and validate it prospectively.
execution_shape.phase_5: Prepared-worker / combined-receiving / R1 permit gates remain separate and do not inherit automatically.

preservation_requirements: all validator stdout/stderr and machine-readable receipts
prohibitions: no schema-only pass represented as semantic completeness
no R1 permit, claim, seed, allocation or gameplay
acceptance_for_design_review: Reviewer confirms every one of the five preflight gaps has an explicit capture and fail-closed rule.
Reviewer confirms no required archive member, build input, platform identity, launch-path input, or generated/hidden class family is silently outside scope.
Reviewer chooses/approves the generated-hidden-class policy before execution.
Any required changes produce a new design version before a capture is dispatched.
